system-administration_20260615_143301_00.why: Its two tests are live-network, not file checks. One pipes through `socat - TCP4:127.0.0.1:6666` and asserts `login:` came back over the socket; the other drives an expect script (telnet, login:, consoleuser, Password:, consolepass, shell prompt, `echo LOGIN_SUCCESS`) and requires the echo. The task writes no files at all, so there is no file-exists path to game. The grader scored `"login:" in combined` as a substring check without seeing that `combined` is socket output.
